placement.subject: Urgent
placement.notice:
CDC will start the ERP registration for placement 2026-27 from 17th August 2026 (from 11:00 AM onwards).

Students have to complete their placement registration process (CV building) within 25th August 2026 (11:59 PM). No further extension will be provided.

All the potential eligible students will be provided two consecutive registration windows i.e. one in the month of August, 2026 (for first phase till December) and another in the month of January, 2027 (for second phase till March). By registering in the month of August they can participate in Phase - I placement session i.e in December and by registering in the month of January they can participate in Phase - II placement i.e. from January to March. It is the choice of the students in which phase (Phase - I in December and Phase - II from January to March) they wish to register.

However, once a student is graduated from the Institute he/she will not be permitted to participate in any further placement process, even though he/ she has not availed two opportunities or availed but not placed.

All the students who have accepted the PPO are strictly advised to register for CDC placement, otherwise in CDC placement data their names will be missed out.

Students are advised to keep their CV content ready along with the relevant documents which are required to be uploaded for further verification.

Students are advised to note the followings:

1) For hall related activities - concerned Warden / Asst. Warden may be approached.

2) For Gymkhana related activities including inter IIT-President of Gymkhana may be approached.

3) For activities of various societies- Concerned Head of the Society may be approached.

4) For any activities from outside the institute, including competitions, best paper and conference etc.- mail copy of CONFIRMED PARTICIPATION and congratulatory mail for wining best papers / any prizes, E-certificate is to be uploaded.

5) Project done under In house Faculty (other than academic requirement) - relevant certificate from the Faculty is to be uploaded.

6) Publication: First page of publication/ acceptance of review email/ acceptance letter.

7) Departmental activities/ Student council activities- Relevant proof from concerned Head/ Faculty is to be uploaded.

8) All PORs should be certified properly with the supporting documents.

9) Students are prohibited from mentioning any kind of rank of entrance exams (JEE / GATE / JAM etc.) and current departmental rank in the CV.

10) Students are also not allowed to mention the his/her position (percentage / percentile) in JEE / GATE / JAM etc. in the CV.

11) Other rank mentioned like code challenge rank etc.- is to supported by mail from the company domain/ certificate.

12) Any scholarship is to be supported with proper authenticate documents.

13) For M.

Tech students - B.

Tech projects done elsewhere - proper certificate is to be attached.

14) For Internship Completion Certificate - Duly signed CDC Internship completion form (format attached) / Duly signed internship completion certificate of a company / duly signed internship completion certificate from the Research Guide of the Research , Educational Institute / Email from the HR or Team Manager (Mail must be from company domain , company email id with designation and mobile number).

15) The size of the PDF must be less than 300 KB to be uploaded in ERP.

CDC, IIT Kharagpur

internship.subject: Urgent
internship.notice:
Kind attention: CDC Internship registered students:

a) The internship interview process will be conducted at Nalanda only.

b) Keep your pen, notepad, copy of your CV (at least 6/7 copies), all electronic gadgets handy. CDC Office will not entertain any requests from the candidates to print out their CVs during the process.

c) Keep one Govt ID card, Institute ID card handy.

d) Dress code is formal.

e) As the process is being conducted online / offline / hybrid mode , your process may be preponed or postponed. Hence be available in mobile and check CDC notice board. CDC office/ Placecom member may call you at any time. Be vigilant.

f) You are advised to behave properly with courtesy with the company officials, placecom and CDC office.

g) Student should refrain themselves to indulge in any malpractices which may tarnish the image of the Institute. If CDC receives any complaint from the company suitable disciplinary action will be taken as per Institute/ CDC policy.

h) CDC office will publish the shortlist in advance in CDC Notice board (ERP). The students are advised to keep checking CDC Notice Board (in ERP) at regular intervals.

i) Students having multiple shortlists will be accommodated in a particular way, so that they can attend the same. The same will be communicated in advance. Be vigilant and attend the phone calls, whatsapp messages from Placecom/ CDC office.

j) No student is allowed to disclose any information pertaining to the date of interview, the time of interview, the roles offered, the stipend offered, and the eligibility criteria of any company while interviewing for, or interacting with any other company. In the event of such a happening, CDC will consider it as violation and appropriate action will be taken.

k) CDC office will publish the internship process result in CDC notice board. Single offer will be treated as DEEMED ACCEPTED. Offer acceptance will only be taken from those who has multiple offers.

l) All the students will have to accept the offer in ERP (be it single offer or multiple offer). It is MANDATORY. Please note that once you get a CDC internship offer, you will not be allowed to sit in any further CDC internship process.

m) Any kind of discrepancies in the name/roll number or issues in the declared list may be brought to the notice of CDC on the same day. CDC helpline number -03222-281870 (only available on the days of interview, during office hours).

internship.subject: Urgent
internship.company: Travelling window for potentially eligible students for Internship 2026-27
internship.notice:
All the students who will register for CDC internship process of 2026-27 may note:

Travel window for the potentially eligible students for internship will be from 10th July to 12th July, 2026.

All the tests (if conducted) before the travel window time will be conducted online, that means students can write their tests / process from their respective locations.

From 18th July 2026 onwards all the tests may be conducted at Nalanda and student must come to Nalanda to write the test / process, otherwise their candidature will be treated as null and void.

CDC, IIT Kharagpur

Opening of CV portal for CDC Internship registration _2026-27

All the potential eligible students of compulsory Internship (who will go for internship 2027 summer) are advised to kindly note the followings:

CV Portal in ERP for CV building (for Internship) is being started from today (22/06/2026) and will be open till 27th June 2026, 11.59 pm

b) By enrolling in the CDC Internship portal, you are also confirming that, you will go for compulsory internship in the year 2027 from May to Mid-July (as per academic schedule).

c) Please pass this message to your fellow mates who will go for compulsory internship in the year 2027.

d) Registration for Internship is must and 

CDC, IIT Kharagpur is requesting all the students to participate in internship activities with positive spirit.
